loop.meaning: A video game and internet term used to describe exaggerated bouncing or movement of body parts, especially breasts or buttocks, during animation.
loop.example: Bro, the new game engine has insane jiggle physics.
loop.context: Often brought up while discussing video game graphics, anime, or reels joking about unrealistic character design. Casual tone.

loop.meaning: A social psychological phenomenon where individuals are less likely to offer help to a victim when other people are present.
loop.example: Everyone just stood there filming the fight instead of helping because of the bystander effect.
loop.context: Used in serious or analytical discussions on podcasts or reels when breaking down why crowds fail to act in emergencies.

loop.term: Bro really thought he was him
loop.meaning: A mocking caption or phrase used when someone tries to act cool, confident, or heroic and completely fails.
loop.example: Did you see him try to skateboard and faceplant? Bro really thought he was him.
loop.context: Used in comment sections of Instagram reels or YouTube shorts showing cringe or embarrassing fails.

loop.meaning: To visibly and overwhelmingly outshine someone else in physical attractiveness, height, or presence when standing next to them.
loop.example: He walked into the room and totally mogged everyone there.
loop.context: Commonly used in gym culture, fitness reels, and among Gen Z guys joking about appearance. Can sound arrogant if overused.

loop.meaning: Someone who does way too much for a person they're attracted to, often without getting anything back.
loop.example: He drove 40 km at midnight to deliver her momos. Simp.

loop.meaning: Giving someone just enough attention (likes, occasional texts) to keep them hooked without commitment.
loop.example: He never makes plans, just reacts to her stories every few days.
loop.context: Dating behaviour that keeps someone waiting.

loop.meaning: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer/Questioning, Intersex, Asexual, and others.
loop.example: The college started an LGBTQIA+ support group.
loop.context: Umbrella term for gender and sexual minorities.

loop.meaning: Too many options make us more anxious and less satisfied with our decision.
